name: fbi-crime-mcp-server
description: Exposes the FBI Crime Data Explorer API — monthly UCR offense rates and counts, hate crime, arrest, and NIBRS breakdowns by national, state, or agency scope, agency ORI search, annual law enforcement staffing, and LEOKA officer-safety statistics via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

fbi_api_key.title: FBI CDE API Key
fbi_api_key.description: api.data.gov API key for the FBI Crime Data Explorer. Free at https://api.data.gov/signup/.

fbi_clamp_limits.title: Clamp oversized agency pages
fbi_clamp_limits.description: Serve an fbi_search_agencies limit above 200 at 200 with a notice. Disable to reject a larger limit.
